create_Materials_default: create a Materials instance with default white ambient, diffuse, and specular colors and shininess 64
create_Materials_custom_colors: create a Materials instance with custom RGB ambient, diffuse, and specular colors on a GPU device
create_Materials_batch: create a batch of Materials with per-element ambient, diffuse, specular colors and shininess values
clone_Materials: clone an existing Materials instance to create an independent copy with the same properties
review_Materials_validation: review the Materials class constructor to understand RGB color shape validation and shininess shape checks
